svg.title: How an owner gets a release app
svg.desc: You copy the blueprint with the question of the release app left empty. python3 .github/blueprint.py app register registers the app on your account or organization: you confirm one page, it sets the private key, and it opens the pull request that names the app. You install the app and merge the pull request. Then settings apply sets the variables and the ruleset of the release tags, and the bots run as your app; until then each bot that acts as it says in its summary what is missing.
